title: 74 cards sit on `pm:on-hold` and nothing re-measures the gates — objectui#7051's precondition had been satisfied for days before a dev noticed by accident
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`). ⛔ Not claimed. **This is a process defect in the seat that files it**, recorded because the failure is structural rather than personal — the next PM will have it too.

## What happened

objectui#7051 (*"page `record:details` sections and view `form.sections` resolve `group:` keys via `deriveFieldGroupLayout`"*) carried this gate:

> ⛔ **Sequencing gate — do not start before** objectstack#13855's spec PR is merged **AND objectui has adopted the `@objectstack/*` version carrying it.**

Last measurement recorded on the card: **2026-09-03**, result NO.

Today the objectui#8497 dev measured, incidentally and for another reason, that **`@objectstack/spec` 17.3.0 is installed and declares `group` on `RecordDetailsProps.sections`**. The gate had cleared. Nobody had re-checked it, so the card sat on hold with its precondition met — and this seat dispatched objectui#8497 into the same territory without seeing it.

The overlap was found **by a dev reading the backlog its PM had stopped reading.**

## ⚠️ Two kinds of hold, and conflating them is the dangerous repair

Of the **74** open `pm:on-hold` cards, the label covers two populations that need opposite treatment:

**Gate-held** — waiting on a *measurable* condition, which nothing re-measures:
- objectui#7051 — spec version carrying objectstack#13855 · **cleared, now unheld**
- objectui#5919 — *"gated on the stage-1 deprecation shipping"*
- objectui#5831 — *"when the spec dependency next syncs"*
- objectui#6328 — *"release-gated on the spec version containing objectstack#11408"*
- objectui#5291 — *"once `@objectstack/spec` publishes the canonical slot"*
- objectui#5892, objectui#5817, objectui#6354 — stage-2 / deprecation-window cards
- objectui#7614, objectui#7597, objectui#7588, objectui#5920, objectui#5987, objectui#6246 — "the consumer/UI half of objectstack#…"

**Ruling-held** — deferred by an explicit decision, correctly frozen until someone rules again:
- objectui#7716 — *"deferred — own feature card, **zero measured pull**, not part of the bump"* (director ruling, maintainer verbatim)

⛔ **A sweep that un-holds by age, or by "the label is stale", would reverse maintainer rulings.** objectui#7716's gate is not a condition to re-measure; it is a decision. Any mechanism proposed here must distinguish the two, and the safe default for an ambiguous card is **leave it held**.

## What is actually asked

Not "unhold things". The ask is that a **gate-held card's condition gets re-measured on a schedule**, and that the two populations become distinguishable without reading every body.

Options, none ruled:

1. **A second label** — `pm:on-hold:gated` vs `pm:on-hold:ruled` — so a sweep can address only the first. Cheap; costs a one-time triage pass over 74 cards.
2. **A machine-readable gate line** on gate-held cards (e.g. a `Gate:` field naming a package and a minimum version) so a script can answer "is this still held?" — the strongest, and the only one that survives a PM who stops reading.
3. **A recurring PM duty**: re-measure gate-held cards on some cadence. Weakest, because it failed exactly this way already.

⭐ Option 2 is the only one that does not depend on someone remembering. But it only covers gates that are **version-shaped** — *"once the deprecation window closes"* and *"the UI half of objectstack#X"* are not, and forcing them into a schema would be worse than leaving them prose. Measure how many of the 74 are version-shaped before designing anything.

## ⚠️ Adjacent, already actionable

objectui#7716's body records that **objectui#7465's premise has changed** — at 17.3.0 the spec *declares* `showBorder`, so that card's option A *"has effectively happened upstream and its fork collapses"*. Filed today, objectui#8583 measures the same territory from the other side: `@object-ui/types`' `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[]` omits six spec-declared keys (`columns`, `icon`, `description`, `showBorder`, `defaultCollapsed`, `headerColor`) and declares one the spec refuses (`collapsed`).

⇒ objectui#7465 should be re-verified on the merged ref before anyone touches it, and read together with objectui#8583. That is a second gate-held premise that moved without anyone noticing.

## Related

objectui#7051 (the card that surfaced this; now off hold and re-scoped) · objectui#8497 / PR #8584 (the overlapping dispatch, and the dev report that caught it) · objectui#7716 (the ruling-held example, and objectui#7465's changed premise) · objectui#8583

## Dedup

⚠️ **Declared, NOT claimed.** This repo's issue search returns **false zeros** — measured four separate times today, including `total_count: 0` for `ValueDataSource` while objectui#8447's own title carries that word. **No dedup claim is made.** Suggested manual check: any card about `pm:on-hold` hygiene or backlog sweeps.
